The '''Hoodu Geyser Fields''' were a number of [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]] [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The fields were part of the [[Grabvine Gateway/Legends|Grabvine Gateway]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course. The end of the fields was marked by a gigantic statue.
